query: SELECT count(*) AS "total!" FROM series_browse sb WHERE ($1::content_type IS NULL OR sb.content_type = $1) AND ($2::series_status IS NULL OR sb.status = $2) AND ($3::int IS NULL OR sb.release_year >= $3) AND ($4::int IS NULL OR sb.release_year <= $4) AND ($5::text IS NULL OR sb.provider_ids @> ARRAY[COALESCE( (SELECT p.id FROM providers p WHERE p.slug = $5), '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)]) AND ($6::int IS NULL OR sb.max_chapters >= $6) AND (cardinality($7::text[]) = 0 OR sb.tag_ids @> ARRAY( SELECT COALESCE(t.id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) FROM unnest($7::text[]) AS x(slug) LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.slug = x.slug)) AND (cardinality($8::text[]) = 0 OR NOT sb.tag_ids && ARRAY( SELECT t.id FROM tags t WHERE t.slug = ANY($8::text[]))) AND (NOT sb.adult_gated OR $9) AND ($10::uuid IS NULL OR $11::bool IS NULL OR $11 = EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM watchlist_entries w WHERE w.series_id = sb.series_id AND w.user_id = $10))
